title: alnus orientalis f. tomentosa
intro: Alnus orientalis f. tomentosa, commonly known as Downy White Alder, is a plant species within the birch family (Betulaceae) characterized by its unique, hairy leaves and white or gray bark. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and protecting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Alnus orientalis f. tomentosa include its ability to calm the nervous system, improve digestion, and provide relief from respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
